title: Art. 9.1.10 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 9 - Aerodrome Operational Services, Equipment and Installations, 9.1 Aerodrome emergency planning, 9.1.10
content: Recommendation. A person should be assigned to assume control of the emergency operations centre and, when appropriate, another person the command post.
